args.sql:
-- Build CTEs for both classifications
WITH fan_sls AS (
    SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot as fan_id, 
           SUM((s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::numeric + (s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::numeric + (s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::numeric) as total_sls
    FROM interactions i
    JOIN supportandfeedback s ON i.activity_reg = s.support_interact_pivot
    GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
),
fan_churn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot as fan_id, r.churn_flag
    FROM retentionandinfluence r
    JOIN engagement e ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engage_member_pivot = m.member_reg
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN fs.total_sls > 10 THEN 'Needy' ELSE 'Not Needy' END as needy_status,
    CASE WHEN fc.churn_flag = 'High' THEN 'At-Risk' ELSE 'Not At-Risk' END as risk_status,
    COUNT(*) as fan_count
FROM fans f
LEFT JOIN fan_sls fs ON f.user_registry = fs.fan_id
LEFT JOIN fan_churn fc ON f.user_registry = fc.fan_id
GROUP BY 
    CASE WHEN fs.total_sls > 10 THEN 'Needy' ELSE 'Not Needy' END,
    CASE WHEN fc.churn_flag = 'High' THEN 'At-Risk' ELSE 'Not At-Risk' END
ORDER BY needy_status, risk_status;
